# Connect UnifAPI to Claude

> Web connector — the smoothest path · read-only public-data MCP over OAuth — **eyes, not hands**.

Connect Claude to the UnifAPI public-data MCP server and run marketing research — SEO, AI-visibility (GEO), social, local, and competitive intelligence — from live public data without leaving Claude. A web connector — a couple of clicks, no terminal. One OAuth sign-in, no API key to paste; everything is read-only.

## Steps

### 1. Open the connector dialog

In Claude, open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.

[Open Add Connector](https://claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector)

### 2. Add UnifAPI

Name it "UnifAPI" and paste the server URL:

```text
https://mcp.unifapi.com
```

Leave Authentication as OAuth, then Add and Connect.

### 3. Try it with Claude

```text
Use UnifAPI to pull the current top Hacker News story and summarize it.
```

[Open Claude with task](https://claude.ai/new?q=Use%20UnifAPI%20to%20pull%20the%20current%20top%20Hacker%20News%20story%20and%20summarize%20it.)
